description.en: Before a phase that ships model behaviour: selects the AI framework and model, researches it, and writes AI-SPEC.md with typed inputs and outputs, failure guards, the evaluation plan and the cost ceiling.
description.ru: Перед фазой с поведением модели: выбирает ИИ-фреймворк и модель, исследует их и пишет AI-SPEC.md с типами входа и выхода, защитой от сбоев, планом оценки и потолком стоимости.

ru: Спланируй интеграцию ИИ в эту фичу
Какую модель и фреймворк взять для генерации?
Нужна оценка качества генерации до разработки
en: Plan the AI integration of this feature
Which model and framework for the generation?
Write the AI-SPEC for the phase
We need an eval plan before building

nodes.prompt: AI framework selector: from the goal, choose the kind of call (typed judgment, generation, retrieval, ranking), the framework and the model. Build a decision matrix of 2–3 options: rows are the options, columns the criteria (cost per call, latency, limits, failure modes, fit to the goal), each scored 0–5 with a one-line reason and a weight. Recommend the option with the highest weighted total; the table goes in the reply and in .agents/research/model-<slug>.md.

Framework researcher: current docs, limits and prices of the chosen framework and model, with links and dates; pitfalls others hit. Return quick_reference (API shape, limits, prices, pitfalls with links and dates), implementation_notes (call pattern, retries, the schema of the answer) and domain_notes (what a domain expert judges a good result by, the failure modes known in the industry, the regulation that binds, each with a source).

Evaluation plan before any prompt is tuned: a gold set of 20-50 cases covering the edges, the metric that tracks the user goal, the threshold and why, the cost ceiling, and how a regression is noticed. Use the domain's expert criteria, failure modes and regulation from research.domain_notes.

Write .agents/phases/<id>/AI-SPEC.md (lane-plan template fill AI-SPEC --phase …): framework and model, typed inputs and outputs, failure modes and guards (timeout, fallback, ceiling), cost per call. It must hold the sections '## Quick reference' and '## Implementation guidance' from the research, and an '## Evaluation' section with dimensions (what quality means for this feature, grounded in domain_notes), a rubric per dimension with the gold-set cases, guardrails (checks on input and output at run time), monitoring (how a regression is noticed after release), metric and threshold. See templates/planning/references/ai-systems.md.

Read .agents/phases/<id>/AI-SPEC.md. ok=true only when every section is present (framework and model, typed inputs and outputs, guards, '## Evaluation' with dimensions, rubrics, guardrails and monitoring, '## Quick reference', '## Implementation guidance', cost), the numbers are consistent and no secret is in it. Otherwise name the gaps.
